== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|An Awakened object is an inanimate item that has undergone a mysterious and poorly understood transformation through a process known as [[Awakening]]. This procedure, performed by [[Readers]], blends the [[Intent]] of the object itself with the [[Intent]] of both [[the Reader]] and the owner. The process grants the item a rudimentary level of awareness or consciousness, which is directly tied to its original purpose and goals. While these objects are not living beings, they can demonstrate independence, such as performing tasks or reacting to their surroundings based on their inherent nature. During [[Awakening]], an object's physical appearance and structure can be permanently altered to better align with its purpose or collected [[Intent]]. However, this transformation occurs only once; an Awakened object cannot be reshaped further, nor can it undergo the [[Awakening]] process a second time or absorb new [[Intent]]. The resulting powers of an object are often unpredictable and difficult to fully comprehend without extensive study. A significant application of this process is the creation of [[Vessels]], which are [[Awakened objects]] used by [[Soulbound]] individuals to draw upon immense power. While anyone can use an Awakened item, only a [[Soulbound]] can wield its full potential freely. Because these objects serve as the source of a [[Soulbound]]'s abilities, identifying and potentially destroying a [[Vessel]] is a critical tactic in combat.}}
